The Memory of Your Smile by the Stanley Brothers
The Stanley Brothers  (King 615)
Recorded at King Studios Cincinnati, Ohio
Date: September 30, and October 1, 1958
YouTube: Starts at 21:18 ends at 23:37
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zSEqHSSRNK4&t=124s
Capo: 1st fret
Key: G


[Intro]
[ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]D[/ch]
[ch]G[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]

[tab][ch]C[/ch]                           [ch]G[/ch]
I'm walking from one bar to another[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                      [ch]D[/ch]                   [ch]G[/ch]

[tab][ch]C[/ch]
No one I meet realizes[/tab]
